text: In metabolic engineering, the 'TRY' metrics used to evaluate a production strain stand for which three quantities?
explanation: TRY stands for Titer (product concentration in the culture), Rate (volumetric productivity), and Yield (product per unit substrate) -- the three core metrics for the commercial viability of an engineered strain, which often trade off against one another. The other options substitute plausible-sounding but incorrect terms that are not what TRY denotes.
